target: Hourly produced energy divided by installed capacity

input_units.wind: m/s; supplied 10 m wind converted from km/h
input_units.Gpast1: kW/m2; exact previous native-clock hour supplied radiation

timing_contract: Same native-clock current weather plus exact previous1/2hour weather; energy response is not predictor. Physical reporting/timezone semantics unresolved.
calibration: Strict past weather history added without shifting energy or provider/timezone assumptions. No plant-specific response calibration.

reference.equation: yhat = offset + sum beta_j phi_j(inputs), with exact frozen terms/clocks in rules.json and run.py::design; clipping only for photovoltaic energy. Legacy model has exact original runtime/state.

compact_candidate.equation: G_eff=(1−m)G(t)+m G(t−1hour); yhat=clip(G_eff[b0+b1 cos(s)+b2 sin(s)+b3 h+b4 h²+b5 h cos(s)],0,connection/installed); s=2pi*doy/365.25,h=(hour−12)/12.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: Six cities, nine plants; plants within a city share weather and are not independent weather sites. Same-hour conditional energy prediction, not weather forecasting or proven thermal causality.

exposure.historical_record: ALL original confirmation exposed; no fresh confirmation; diagnostics opened only after candidate/stopping freeze; all future evaluations are retrospective

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
